title: centella tridentata var. dregeana
intro: Centella tridentata var. dregeana, commonly known as Mountain Centella, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae, native to South Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Centella are attributed to its ability to promote tissue repair, reduce inflammation, and improve wound closure. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Centella include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
